name: East City Park Campground
note: City of Ainsworth park on the Cowboy Trail. ~7-8 grass sites with 30-amp electric pedestals plus water; FCFS, dump station $5 (tents $7). Open April-October. Restrooms; showers reported. Big-rig friendly per reviews. --Claude

name: Karrer Park
note: City of McCook campground at the east edge of town on US-6/34. Closed in 2025 and open again in 2026, by reservation only (campers stayed in July and October 2026). The bathrooms and showers are out of order (city page, read 2026-11-05). One water hydrant in the centre; no water or sewer at the sites. One tent may accompany a camper; otherwise no tents. Entry has a tight turn. --Claude

name: Lake North Campground
note: FCFS campground on the north shore of Lake North, operated by Loup Power District (public power district = local operator). Electric hookups plus primitive sites, open big-rig-friendly layout. 7-day limit per 30-day period across the Loup park system. Open May 1-Nov 1 (weather permitting). Potable water May-Sept; no dump station and no direct water hookups. Two beaches, two boat ramps on the ~200-acre lake. --Claude

name: Cabela's RV Park & Campground
note: First-come, first-served RV park beside the original Cabela's store at One Angler's Lane, Sidney (Bass Pro Shops' Cabela's brand), just off I-80, with Walmart and restaurants in walking distance. Gravel pads; big rigs fit. Water at the full-service sites is weather permitting. Call 308-254-7889 for site availability. No open fires; horse corrals by the store. --Claude

name: Creekside RV Park and Campground
note: Small private RV park on the south edge of Chappell, off the I-80 exit 85 road (US-385) just south of the railroad and grain elevators; ~30 full-hookup sites (30/50 A) in gravel rows on open grass. First come, first served, cash or check only; busy in wheat harvest (late June-July), so call ahead. Train noise. Operator asks that you follow directions rather than GPS. --Claude

name: Red Haw State Park
note: Iowa state park on high cliff overlooking 72-acre Red Haw Lake.  Open Apr-Nov.  Some sites wooded, some full sun; threaded potable spigot at dump station; roads and facilities are somewhat poorly maintained.  Two-night regular weekend minimum, three night holiday weekend minimum, May-Oct.  No daily park-entry fee in Iowa, camping fee only.  --AWH  51 public campsites (41 electric, 1 non-electric RV, 9 tent-only) since the campground reopened. 100% reservable on ReserveAmerica and a reservation is required, bookable up to 10 pm on the day of arrival (ReserveAmerica and Iowa DNR, read 2026-10-20). --Claude

Booking: min stay 2 nights on weekends (May 1 to October 31 (Friday and Saturday)), 3 on holidays (Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends; July 4th when it falls on a Monday)

name: Daisy Long Memorial Park
note: Hardin County Conservation park on the Iowa River ~1 mi E of Union, site of the 1856 grist mill, with on-site camp hosts. The river-access boat ramp was posted 'currently in need of repair and unsafe for use' (read 2026-11-02). Sites accommodate ~25 ft, so a 23-ft Class C fits. --Claude

name: Thomas Mitchell Park
note: Polk County Conservation park on 197 acres along Camp Creek near Mitchellville, ~5 mi east of Des Moines off I-80. Construction to expand the campsites is under way (county notice, read 2026-11-02). --Claude

name: Lake Iowa Park
note: Iowa County Conservation park on 83-acre Lake Iowa near Ladora, by the Lake Iowa Nature Center. First-come-first-served only; usually fills only on Memorial Day, Labor Day and the Creepy Camping weekend (last weekend of September), when a site can be held by pitching a tent on it and paying. Shared water spigots through the campground (use a Y connector). Campground hours 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. --Claude

name: Middle Amana Community Park
note: Campground at the Amana Community Park in Middle Amana (Amana Colonies), camping under old oak trees. Who runs it is unconfirmed (Middle Amana is unincorporated, so not a city park), and the visitors bureau page is behind a bot check; electric, water, dump and laundry rest on directory listings (checked 2026-11-03). Lily Lake lies south of the village, not reachable from the camp area. --Claude

name: Wapello Fairgrounds Park
note: City of Wapello camping area at its fairgrounds/rodeo grounds on the north side of town (not the Louisa County fair, which is in Columbus Junction). The city posts nothing about it online; its season, facilities and rate rest on directory listings only (checked 2026-11-03). --Claude

name: Mirror Lake State Park - Cliffwood Campground
note: Cliffwood loop: 35 sites, ~29 with electric; open May-Oct. Many sites accommodate larger rigs. Reservable online. CAVEAT: tentatively closed in the reservation system ~Feb 1-early Aug 2026 for a road-construction project (per WI DNR) - verify before relying on it in 2026. --Claude Rechecked 2026-09-30: the Feb-Aug 2026 construction closure has passed with no newer notice. --Claude

name: Mirror Lake State Park - Sandstone Ridge Campground
note: Sandstone Ridge loop: 68 sites, mix of electric/non-electric; open year-round (a few electric sites plowed in winter). Reservable online. CAVEAT: tentatively closed in the reservation system ~Feb 1-early Aug 2026 for a road-construction project (per WI DNR) - verify before relying on it in 2026. --Claude Rechecked 2026-09-30: the Feb-Aug 2026 construction closure has passed with no newer notice. --Claude

name: Rocky Arbor State Park
note: 89 wooded sites on paved loops; ~18 sites with 30-amp electric, rest primitive. Showers, dump station. Open Memorial Day-Labor Day. Mix of reservable and FCFS; reservable online. --Claude

name: Mill Bluff State Park
note: 21-site rustic family campground; 6 sites with electric, 15 non-electric. Vault toilets, hand-pump water, dump station, no showers. Max RV length 40 ft. Reservable online (some FCFS availability). Open late May-September. --Claude

name: Pike Lake Campground - Kettle Moraine State Forest (Pike Lake Unit)
note: Sunrise family campground in Kettle Moraine SF Pike Lake Unit; 32 sites (24 wooded, 8 open), 11 with electric. Open early April to third weekend of October. Reservable online; unreserved sites FCFS. Showers, flush toilets, dump station. The 3 backpack sites are a separate hike-in area. --Claude

name: Firefly Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Modern (non-electric) NHAL campground, 71 back-in sites (201-271) on the north shore of 27-acre Firefly Lake. Reservable online (reservation required, no FCFS). Flush toilets/showers plus vault toilets, hand-pump water, carry-in boat landing; no electric, free dump 0.5 mi at Crystal Lake. Non-motorized lake. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Crystal Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Modern (non-electric) NHAL campground on the west/south shore of 93-acre Crystal Lake; ~99 sites, 92 drive-in back-in RV/tent plus 7 walk-to tent-only (415-418, 421-423), 2 ADA. Reservable online (no FCFS). Flush toilets/showers, vault toilets, dump station, hand pumps. Non-motorized lake, large sand swim beach. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: South Trout Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic NHAL campground on the SE corner of Trout Lake, 23 sites (1001-1023): 19 drive-in back-in tent/RV plus 4 walk-in tent-only (1013-1016) and 2 doubles. Non-electric; vault toilet, hand-pump water, boat launch. Reservable online (no FCFS); register at Crystal Lake Ranger Station. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Upper Gresham Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic (non-electric) NHAL campground, 25 sites (1501-1525) on the NE corner of Upper Gresham Lake, paved campground roads, seasonal on-site manager. Drive-in for tents/trailers/RVs; sites 1519-1521 are walk-to tent-only. Reservable online (no FCFS). Vault toilets, hand-pump water, beach, boat landing, ADA fishing pier. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Cunard Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic NHAL campground on the SW shore of ~43-acre Cunard Lake; 27 drive-in back-in RV/tent sites plus 7 walk-in tent-only. No hookups; vault toilets, hand-pump water, electric-motor-only lake. Reservable online (no FCFS). Designated quiet zone - generators not allowed. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Indian Mounds Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic NHAL campground on the NE corner of Lake Tomahawk; 39 sites, all non-electric. Mostly drive-in back-in RV/trailer sites plus walk-to tent-only sites (24-27, 29-31). Reservable online (no FCFS); register at nearby Clear Lake Campground. Accepts big rigs. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Sandy Beach Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic drive-in NHAL campground on the SE corner of Sandy Beach Lake; sites 1901-1933 (~30 drive-in back-in tent/RV, walk-to tent-only at 1914-1916). All non-electric; vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat launch, sand beach. Reservable online (no FCFS). Open ~late May-early Oct. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Big Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic drive-in family campground in NHAL, sites 1801-1870 (70 sites), all back-in, gravel spurs off paved campground road. No electricity; hand-pump water and vault toilets. Reservable online (no FCFS). Open ~late Apr-early Nov. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Muskellunge Lake (Musky Lake) Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Officially Muskellunge Lake Campground (locally 'Musky Lake'), sites 301-382 on the SE shore of Big Muskellunge Lake in NHAL. 81 sites, all non-electric, back-in only, paved roads, gravel spurs. Reservable online (no FCFS). Vault toilets plus one flush-toilet/shower building, hand-pump water, boat landing. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Plum Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic drive-in family campground at the SW corner of 1,108-acre Plum Lake; 18 sites (1201-1218), paved roads, on-site host Memorial Day-Labor Day. Vault toilet, hand-pump water, no electricity, beach access. Sites 1208-1210 walk-to/tent-only; 1215 & 1217 are doubles. Reservable online (no FCFS). WI State Parks admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Razorback Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Drive-in rustic state forest campground on the NW corner of Razorback Lake near Sayner; 54 non-electric sites (2101-2154): 47 RV/trailer back-in plus 7 walk-in tent-only. Paved roads, gravel spurs. Vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat launch/swim access. Reservable online (no FCFS). Season ~late May-Oct 1. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Starrett Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Drive-in family rustic campground in NHAL, sites 1301-1344: 36 non-electric back-in drive-in RV/trailer sites plus 6 walk-in tent sites. Vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat launch. Designated quiet zone (no generators). Reservable online (no FCFS). Open ~late Apr-mid Oct. WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: West Star Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: NHAL rustic family campground on the NE corner of Star Lake, sites 1701-1718 (18 non-electric, back-in; doubles 1704-1705 & 1708-1709). Paved roads. Drive-in RV-suitable; vault toilets, hand-pump water, beach access, boat landing. Reservable online (no FCFS). On-site manager mid-May to mid-Oct. WI State Parks admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Clear Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Large modern drive-in family campground (~100 sites, 701-801; ~89 back-in drive-in RV sites plus ~10 walk-in tent-only) on the SW shore of 846-acre Clear Lake in NHAL. No electric (generators 10a-5p). Paved roads, flush toilets/showers, dump station, sandy swim beach, boat landing. Reservable online (no FCFS). WI State Park admission sticker required. --Claude

name: Carrol Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic drive-in family campground (sites 101-119) on Carrol Lake in NHAL between Woodruff and St. Germain. 19 sites: 12 drive-in RV/trailer (back-in, no electric) + 7 walk-in tent-only; vault toilets, hand-pump water, swim beach, boat launch, no dump station. Reservable online (no FCFS). WI State Park admission sticker required. Site 112 has a long level spur for larger RVs. --Claude

name: Ada Lake Campground
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Laona RD) on 75-acre Ada Lake. 19 sites; majority fit 30 ft+, some 45 ft+. No electric, vault toilets, potable water, swim beach, boat landing. FCFS - not reservable on recreation.gov. Open ~May 2-Oct 15. --Claude

name: Boulder Lake Campground
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Lakewood-Laona RD) on 362-acre Boulder Lake - the forest's largest campground. ~89 single sites plus group sites; back-in sites up to 45 ft; 23 sites with 50-amp electric. Showers, drinking water, vault toilets. Mix of reservable online and FCFS. --Claude

name: Laura Lake Campground
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Laona RD) on the SW shore of 110-acre Laura Lake. 41 sites; back-in 30 to 45 ft+. No electric, vault toilets, drinking water, paved roads. Electric-motor-only lakes; swim beach on adjacent Gordon Lake. Mix of reservable online and FCFS. --Claude

name: Laurel Lake Campground
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on Laurel Lake (Three Lakes-Eagle River Chain). 12 sites; max length varies by site (25 ft: 4,5,8,9,10,12; up to 40 ft: site 2). Vault toilets, drinking water. Mix of reservable online (sites 3-5,9-12) and FCFS. --Claude

name: Lost Lake Campground
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on 86-acre Lost Lake (no motors). 27 single-family non-electric sites; drinking water, accessible facilities, sandy swim beach. Mix of reservable online and FCFS. --Claude

name: Luna-White Deer Lake Campground
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Eagle River-Florence RD) on two non-motorized lakes. 37 single-family sites; max length varies (25 ft min, up to 40 ft). No electric, vault toilets, drinking water. Half the sites front the lakes (lakeshore sites priced higher). Mix of reservable online and FCFS. --Claude

name: Morgan Lake Campground
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Florence RD) on 45-acre Morgan Lake (electric motors only). 18 family sites plus 1 group site; max length varies (25 ft: 1,11,13,15; up to 40 ft). No electric, accessible vault toilets, drinking water, beach and boat ramp. Mix of reservable online and FCFS. --Claude

name: Pine Lake Campground
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Laona RD) on the western shore of 1,667-acre Pine Lake. 12 wooded sites; accommodates trailers 40 ft, most sites 45 ft+. No electric, vault toilet, hand-pump well water, paved boat landing, swim beach. FCFS - listed on recreation.gov but not reservable. Open May 2-Oct 15. (Distinct from the private Hiles-Pine Lake Campground.) --Claude

name: Richardson Lake Campground
note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Lakewood-Laona RD) on the south shore of 47-acre Richardson Lake. 26 wooded sites; several take rigs 45+ ft. Non-electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, swim beach, boat landing. Mix of reservable online and FCFS. --Claude
